news.headline: River Flood Warning still in effect Sun for the Melbourne area — Weather.com alerts for Melbourne list a SEVERE River Flood Warning in effect and a Rip Current Statement until Sun 7:00 PM EST; Orlando has no alerts issued today, with a high of 75°F (low 63°F) and mostly cloudy skies clearing to sun in the afternoon; Melbourne high 78°F

Construction starts on 20-story Sarasota waterfront tower — 1000 Boulevard of the Arts: Kolter Urban has selected Fort Lauderdale-based Moss to lead construction, with the team mobilizing on site; the mixed-use tower brings 117 luxury condominium residences alongside a Hyatt Centric Harborside hotel replacing the demolished Hyatt Regency Sarasota, residences start at $1.5 million, completion slated for 2028

Florida home sales slowed in October — Florida Realtors (released Nov 16): single-family closed sales 19,049, down 10.1% year over year, median price $420,000 up 2.2%; condo-townhouse sales 6,862, down 5%, median $290,000 down 3.3%; new pending single-family sales down 15.7%

Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31, 2026 — the edition in effect on the permit application date governs the work for the life of the permit; the 2026 codes are based on the 2024 International Codes and include the 2023 National Electrical Code, and Miami-Dade portal submissions after 4 PM Dec 30 will be subject to the 2026 edition

Copper suffers worst week of 2026 — Comex copper fell more than 9% for the week through Fri Nov 20, with the front contract at about $5.46/lb Friday, its lowest since March; copper is down nearly 16% in the past month, from $6.67/lb on Oct 28 to $5.45 on Friday, as hedge funds cut net longs to 28,700 contracts by Nov 17

Midterm results could accelerate state push for A3 refrigerants — ACHR News: ACCA, PHCC and HARDI warn differing state rules could push ultra-low-GWP A3 refrigerants such as R-290 (propane) before contractors have adjusted to the A2L transition, and urge contractors to monitor state legislation and comment early on proposed refrigerant and code changes

Markets plunge for the week — on Fri Nov 20 the S&P 500 fell 3.7% to 6,910.39, the Nasdaq fell 5.28% to 22,617.73 and the Dow fell 1.93% to 48,147.33; for the week the S&P 500 lost 8.61%, entering correction territory as the AI trade unwound
news.source: Motley Fool / Morningstar (Dow Jones Market Data)

news.headline: Mortgage rates Sun Nov 22 — Bankrate's 30-year fixed national average is 7.41% today (7.40% rate / 7.48% APR in its Nov 22 table, as of 6:30 AM); Mortgage News Daily put the 30-year at 7.33% on Fri Nov 20, its lowest since Nov 10, after the stock selloff pushed the 10-year Treasury below 5%
news.source: Bankrate / Mortgage News Daily via Real Estate News
